name: frozen-claim-drift-detect
title: Detect frozen-claim drift (evidence-integrity §5 follow-on, Phase 1 of 2): bind checklist userSees to a normalized claim-digest + materialHash snapshot and surface a non-blocking FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT advisory when either drifts
description: Phase 1 of the evidence-integrity program §5 follow-on (docs/evidence-integrity-program-spec.md §5). Bind each checklist userSees frozen claim to a snapshot { normalizedClaimDigest, materialHash, headHash, attestedAt } and surface a structured, NON-blocking FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT advisory when EITHER the normalized claim text drifts OR the bound material drifts (rename-aware) under a frozen claim. Bidirectional binding is required because in both source incidents (F-027/F-060 userSees, F-059 plan.md) the claim text stayed frozen while the code moved, so a claim-digest-only check catches neither. Normalization is mechanical (trim + collapse whitespace); no semantic diffing. Legacy userSees with no snapshot are classified legacy-unbound and reported, never errored. Scope: userSees only. Detect + report only — the blocking gate, reviewer re-attestation recovery, and legacy migration policy are Phase 2. Reuses B-ec67 (M1) receipt/freshness and the B-5a9a/B-d243/B-edf1 storyFilesHash drift-advisory pattern.
